review_scope: Read-only independent review of source-preflight fixed-path hosted use; no P13 changes made by reviewer.
verified_boundaries: Parent restoration and authentication precede credential access.
One fixed official-origin request; redirects and environment proxies disabled.
Response body not consumed or preserved; transport errors sanitized.
State bytes hashed before and after; mismatches and HTTP failures return nonzero.
Receipt is outside canonical state and uploaded on failure.
claim_limit: HTTP200 establishes a successful credential-bearing request, not independent proof that the server required or validated the credential.
